# Figure 2. Microbiome

{{< include ../../_extensions/gaospecial/fig-export/_setup.qmd >}}

{{< include _theme-setup.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
# ============================================================
# Figure 2 — 5 panels
# 数据来源: analysis/amplicon/ 下的 wucl 系列分析
# 描述: 玉米种子复苏菌群（玉米水）的自交系 vs 农家种扩增子分析
# ============================================================

setwd(here::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(magrittr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)

# --- 共享数据加载（seed-water） ---
PATH <- "data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/seed-water-all/"

otu_table <- read_csv(file.path(PATH, "asv-table-adjusted.csv"))
first_col <- names(otu_table)[1]
otu_table <- otu_table |> column_to_rownames(var = first_col)
otu_table <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table))

seed_bank_info <- read_csv("data/processed/seed-bank/seed-bank.csv")

sample_table <- read_csv(file.path(PATH, "sample-info.csv"))
first_col_s <- names(sample_table)[1]
sample_table <- sample_table |>
  left_join(seed_bank_info) |>
  mutate(genetic_group = fct_relevel(genetic_group, c("SS", "TST", "NSS", "3K", "Tibet"))) |>
  column_to_rownames(var = first_col_s)

taxon_table <- read_csv(file.path(PATH, "tax-table.csv"))
first_col_t <- names(taxon_table)[1]
taxon_table <- taxon_table |>
  column_to_rownames(var = first_col_t) |>
  mutate(Genus = if_else(Genus == "Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia", "Burkholderia", Genus))

# 构建 microtable 对象
mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
mt$sample_table <- subset(mt$sample_table, genetic_group != "LocalSeed")
mt$tax_table <- subset(mt$tax_table, !is.na(Phylum) & !is.na(Genus))
mt$tidy_dataset()

# --- 分组颜色方案 ---
group_cols <- c(
  SS    = "#E64B35",
  TST   = "#4DBBD5",
  NSS   = "#00A087",
  `3K`  = "#3C5488",
  Tibet = "#F39B7F"
)

material_cols <- c(
  "landraces"    = "#00DCAF",
  "inbred lines" = "#E69F00"
)

anno_colors <- list(
  genetic_group = group_cols,
  material_type = material_cols
)
```

### Panel A：属水平群落结构（按遗传背景分面）

```{r}
#| label: fig2-a-barplot
#| fig-cap: "(A) 属水平群落结构（按遗传背景分面）"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3.5
t1 <- trans_abund$new(dataset = mt, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 6)
f2a = t1$plot_bar(
  others_color = "grey70",
  facet = "genetic_group",
  xtext_keep = FALSE,
  legend_text_italic = TRUE
) + theme_pub()
f2a
```

### Panel B：属水平热图

```{r}
#| label: fig2-b-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "(B) 属水平丰度热图"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3.5
library(ggplotify)

t1 <- trans_abund$new(dataset = mt, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 8)
# 先获取 pheatmap 对象，再转 ggplot —— 走 as.grob.pheatmap 路径，避免重复绘图
f2b_ph <- t1$plot_heatmap(
  group = "genetic_group",
  xtext_keep = FALSE,
  withmargin = FALSE,
  plot_breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
  pheatmap = TRUE,
  treeheight_row = 15,      # 行树宽度缩小
  treeheight_col = 20,      # 列树高度缩小
  # 文字
  fontsize = 8,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,

  silent = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  annotation_col = mt$sample_table[, c("genetic_group", "material_type")],
  annotation_colors = anno_colors
)
f2b <- as.ggplot(f2b_ph)
f2b
```

### Panel C：高丰度菌属（Pantoea、Burkholderia 等）在不同组中的相对丰度

```{r}
#| label: fig2-c-high-abund
#| fig-cap: "(C) 高丰度菌属（Pantoea、Burkholderia 等）在各组中的相对丰度"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
t1 <- trans_abund$new(dataset = mt, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 4)

# 提取数据自定义绘图
plot_data <- t1$data_abund

top6_taxa <- plot_data |>
  distinct(Taxonomy, all_mean_abund) |>
  arrange(desc(all_mean_abund)) |>
  slice_head(n = 4) |>
  pull(Taxonomy)

plot_data <- plot_data |> filter(Taxonomy %in% top6_taxa)
plot_data$genetic_group <- factor(plot_data$genetic_group,
                                   levels = levels(mt$sample_table$genetic_group))
plot_data$Taxonomy <- factor(plot_data$Taxonomy, levels = top6_taxa)

f2c <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = genetic_group, y = Abundance, fill = genetic_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, coef = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Taxonomy, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
f2c
```



### Panel D：Alpha 多样性比较

```{r}
#| label: fig2-d-alpha
#| fig-cap: "(D) Alpha 多样性比较"
# Alpha 多样性分析需要使用原始 counts（未校正批次效应）进行抽平
otu_raw <- read_csv(file.path(PATH, "asv-table-rawcount.csv"))
first_col_or <- names(otu_raw)[1]
otu_raw <- otu_raw |> column_to_rownames(var = first_col_or)
otu_raw <- as.data.frame(t(otu_raw))

sample_raw <- read_csv(file.path(PATH, "sample-info.csv"))
first_col_sr <- names(sample_raw)[1]
sample_raw <- sample_raw |>
  left_join(seed_bank_info) |>
  mutate(genetic_group = fct_relevel(genetic_group, c("SS", "TST", "NSS", "3K", "Tibet"))) |>
  column_to_rownames(var = first_col_sr)

taxon_raw <- read_csv(file.path(PATH, "tax-table.csv"))
first_col_tr <- names(taxon_raw)[1]
taxon_raw <- taxon_raw |>
  column_to_rownames(var = first_col_tr) |>
  mutate(Genus = if_else(Genus == "Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia", "Burkholderia", Genus))

mt_raw <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_raw, sample_table = sample_raw, tax_table = taxon_raw)
mt_raw$sample_table <- subset(mt_raw$sample_table, genetic_group != "LocalSeed")
mt_raw$tax_table <- subset(mt_raw$tax_table, !is.na(Phylum) & !is.na(Genus))
mt_raw$tidy_dataset()

# 抽平到最小测序深度
mt_rar <- clone(mt_raw)
mt_rar$rarefy_samples(sample.size = min(mt_raw$sample_sums()))

# 计算 Alpha 多样性指标
measures <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
mt_rar$cal_alphadiv(measures = measures)

t1 <- trans_alpha$new(dataset = mt_rar, group = "genetic_group")
t1$cal_diff(method = "KW_dunn", KW_dunn_letter = TRUE)

plots <- lapply(measures, function(x) {
  t1$plot_alpha(measure = x, add_sig = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA) + 
    theme_pub() +
    labs(subtitle = x, y = NULL)
})

f2d = wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4, guides = "collect")
f2d
```

### Panel E：CCREPE 共发生网络

```{r}
#| label: fig2-e-network
#| fig-cap: "(E) CCREPE 共发生网络"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(ccrepe)

# CCREPE method based on NetCoMi package
t1_net <- trans_network$new(dataset = mt, cor_method = "ccrepe", filter_thres = 1e-04, taxa_level = "Genus")
t1_net$cal_network(COR_p_thres = 0.05, COR_cut = 0.05)
t1_net$cal_module()

# 获取节点和边表
t1_net$get_node_table(node_roles = TRUE)
t1_net$get_edge_table()

# 自定义 ggraph 可视化
net_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(t1_net$res_network)
node_df <- t1_net$res_node_table
tg <- tbl_graph(nodes = node_df, edges = net_df, directed = FALSE)

f2e = ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight, colour = label), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("+" = "#b2182b", "-" = "#2166ac")) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.8, 2.5)) +
  geom_node_point(aes(colour = Genus, size = Abundance)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6), name = "Abundance") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = 2, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(0.2)) +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
f2e
```

)
